messages:
Eve (AE): Cerulean Health wants a 10-day POC. Highlights: bulk SCIM import, encrypted SAML assertions, multi-domain TXT proof, IdP->RBAC mapping, and Dedicated pricing for SSO peaks. Any quick no-go items?
Ravi (SE): We can do the POC in hosted. Bulk CSV ingest for initial ~30k users + SCIM deltas (~1k/day). We support SCIM v2 PATCH for group sync.
Nora (Sec): SAML encryption: we support assertion + NameID encryption with customer certs. Confirm algorithms (they asked for RSA-OAEP + AES-256-GCM). Ok with that.
Luis (Infra): If they want VPC/private it's ~10 business days. Hosted with region pin and CMK is 48-72h. Need KMS ARN if they want CMK.
Eve (AE): They want encrypted attributes (email, roles) and immediate session revoke on deprovision.
Nora (Sec): Session revoke supported via webhook; hosted best-effort <60s. Recommend short session TTL on client.
Ravi (SE): RBAC mapping: SCIM groups -> Redwood roles, and SAML transient claims for elevated session perms. Ask for sample group names and SAML attribute names.
Grace (Legal): They require SOC2 + DPA. We'll provide standard docs. Also want explicit clause that customer manages DNS TXT proof for domains.
ops-bot: Action: "poc-scim-boost" scheduled to run in 2h on staging for 3h window. Reply "cancel" to abort.
Eve (AE): I'll collect SP metadata, sample CSV (first 500 rows), domains list, and KMS ARN. Ravi/Nora please draft a one-pager for their security team by EOD. Thanks!
